groups.ships: Code in Bun's source that came from another project, under that project's licence.

components.name: Bun copied WebCore and bindings BSD-2-Clause
Bun copied WebCore and bindings BSD-3-Clause
Bun copied WebCore and bindings LGPL-2.0-or-later
Bun copied WebCore and bindings MIT
kprotty Channel
components.note: Its source states no licence, and the audit could not establish the original's: channel.rs names a kprotty gist but contains no licence or pinned gist revision; likely runtime bun_threading code. Both Linux runtime graphs reach the owning crate; included conservatively as a normal runtime input. Licence provenance remains unresolved, not linkage.

components.name: Port of @handlebars/parser
components.note: Its source states no licence, and the audit could not establish the original's: Bun LICENSE.md and src/lint or src/format attribution; runtime directly includes bun_lint_driver; released binary contains rule diagnostics and fmt command. Bun gives no exact upstream pin; nearest identifiable published release at or before Bun tag date, selected by npm publication time. Upstream archive and repository publish no licence file or grant; npm package metadata declares ISC. Licence-text provenance remains unresolved.

components.name: Port of crate fast-glob
components.note: Its source states no licence, and the audit could not establish the original's: src/glob/pattern.rs explicitly names port of validate from fast-glob 1.1.1. Source port, not a Cargo dependency; archive SHA256 verified.
